transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi. Thank you. Well, what finally made me ask for help is that I just keep forgetting little things that I normally handle without an issue. Like, I'll forget to return phone calls, or I won't remember to turn in a registration form, or even just... forgetting to stop for an errand on the way home. It's just been happening enough lately that I figured I should come in and talk to someone about it.
Have you been feeling depressed or down most days lately?
No, I haven't really felt depressed. I mean, it gets a little frustrating when I keep forgetting things, especially at work, but I wouldn't say I feel down most days. My mood has been mostly fine.
Did you have trouble with attention or forgetfulness like this back when you were a child?

Yes, actually. Even in elementary school, I was the kid who always forgot permission slips or lost my homework somewhere in my backpack. I usually needed my mother or my teachers to remind me step by step just to get projects finished. It's always been something I've struggled with, I guess.
Have you had these attention and forgetfulness problems continuously since childhood, or did they start only recently?

Well, they've always kind of been there in the background, like I said, but... it hasn't always been this bad. I'd say these attention and organization problems have been noticeably harder to manage since I started an evening certificate program. That was about 15 months ago. So they didn't just start out of nowhere, but they definitely got a lot more obvious to me then.
Have you been feeling unusually worried or anxious most days?
No, not really. I mean... I get a little stressed if I'm falling behind on things, but I wouldn't say I'm unusually worried or anxious most days. I feel pretty normal in that regard.
Do these attention and forgetfulness problems cause difficulties in more than one area of your life, such as work, school, or home?

Yeah, it does affect both work and school. I mean, I'm still getting by, for the most part, but... well, I've missed some small follow-ups at work lately. And then with my classes, I've let a few deadlines slip, too. It's happening often enough that I'm starting to worry it could really affect my reputation. I'm hoping to move into an Office Manager role eventually, and, you know, you can't really do that if people think you're dropping the ball on the little things.
Before age 12, were you already having these kinds of attention or organization problems?

Yes, I was. Even back in elementary school, I was always the kid who forgot to bring permission slips home, or I'd lose my finished homework somewhere in the bottom of my backpack. My mom and my teachers constantly had to remind me step by step just to get projects finished. So, yeah, it's been an issue for a long time.
